title: Nuclear binding and mass defect
hook: Change mass defect and predict binding energy.
misconception: binding energy stays fixed when mass defect doubles.
objective: Apply binding energy = Δm c² to compare binding energy when mass defect changes, under the stated assumptions.

claims.text: With a fixed conversion factor c², binding energy = Δm c². When mass defect doubles, binding energy becomes 2 times its original value.
claims.source: Idealized model binding energy = Δm c²; scaling exponent 1. Physics and assumptions await independent review.

recall.question: Consider a fixed conversion factor c², with a nonzero initial result. If mass defect triples from a positive value, what is the multiplier on binding energy?
recall.why: Apply binding energy = Δm c² under the same assumptions: the multiplier is 3.
